newsitem.title: USA: Dove raises profit forecast on Wilde film.
newsitem.headline: Dove raises profit forecast on Wilde film.

text.p: Dove Entertainment Inc President and Chief Executive Michael Viner said Monday the company has increased its projected profit to between $3 million and $5 million for a film on Oscar Wilde it expects to release this spring.
Internal projects "had a $1 million profit," Viner said in a telephone interview with Reuters. "It now looks like a $3-$5 million profit."
The new projections are based on a director's cut of "Wilde" that screened Friday in England, where it was very well received, he said.

Last year, Dove acquired all the North American distribution rights to "Wilde" for about $2 million. Dove plans to publish several Oscar Wilde books and audio books to coincide with the film's release.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk 212 859-1713))
